fields.proposed_value: Discovery call with the COO and Sales Operations Manager. Acme manages 60 future users' accounts in spreadsheets and Outlook, losing account history and missing two renewals last quarter. They want one place for accounts, deals and renewals, integrated with their in-house TMS, with USD 80,000-100,000 per year and go-live by March 2027. A technical scoping workshop with Rui was agreed for the week of 9 Nov.
